author: ThioJoe
description:
We're in the dark days of cyber security, buy why?

It seems like there's a new data breach of company hacked every week. But is there really an increase in hacks, or are we just hearing more about them? Well it's actually both. So in this video I discuss why I think hacks are seemingly more common. It's a combination of factors of behavior from both sides.
